subject: Fix lua module build failure when using CLANG (#2955)
reason: The change only edits src/modules/lua/Makefile: it detects clang, switches -std=c99 to -std=gnu11, and adds -fuse-ld=lld for clang linking. It is a build-system fix with no runtime behaviour change — no command, reply, replication, persistence or cluster path is affected, so there is nothing a fuzzer scenario could exercise; build correctness is verified by CI compiling the module.
